notes.title: Bubble Ghost Remake – Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for continuing to play Bubble Ghost Remake. This new update includes several gameplay improvements and bug fixes to further polish the experience.

Improvements

- You can now change the difficulty at any time
  Switch between modes without restarting your run.

- Some difficulty spikes have been balanced
  Adjustments made to specific levels for smoother progression.

Fixes

- The mouse pointer now hides when playing with keyboard and mouse
  A small but helpful tweak to keep the screen clean while playing.

- AZERTY keyboards are now properly supported
  Full compatibility with AZERTY key layouts.

- Minor bugs fixed

Thanks again for all your feedback. We’re continuing to improve the game!

– The Nakama Game Studio Team

notes.title: 👻 Bubble Ghost Remake – Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Bubble Ghost Remake!
We've been listening to your feedback, and this patch focuses on improving accessibility, adding new audio content, and polishing key areas to make the experience smoother and more enjoyable.

🆕 Highlights:

• Checkpoints added in Normal difficulty
You can now resume progress from mid-level checkpoints, reducing frustration without removing the challenge.

• "Accessible" mode is now called "Easy"
A clearer name for a mode designed for players who want a more relaxed experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/e0780c93852712064c66aab9202f4eb96806642f.png

• Hard mode is now unlocked from the beginning
No need to beat the game first — players looking for the toughest challenge can dive right in from the start.

• Level balancing for better accessibility
We’ve tweaked certain levels to reduce difficulty spikes that were causing unnecessary roadblocks.

• New music tracks added to levels
We've expanded the soundtrack to better accompany your ghostly adventure. More variety, more immersion!

• Heinrich now whistles over 150 well-known tunes when bored
Stop moving for a bit and listen closely… our ghost has quite the repertoire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/2034eda06ea69aa83706bea5ed21c25172e5ab4f.png

🐞 Fixes:

– Fixed a bug that caused a cinematic to end prematurely.
– Fixed an issue that prevented collectibles from being picked up after completing a Madness level.

notes.title: Bubble Ghost Remake Release Date Announced: Coming March 27th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/f8bac4240fbce68b612e6762190e3e5c67df9310.jpg

The iconic Bubble Ghost is back with a revamped adventure and a fresh artistic style! Bubble Ghost Remake launches on March 27th for PC (Steam) and Nintendo Switch.

With over 40 challenging levels, epic boss fights, and multiple game modes, this remake blends nostalgia and innovation to bring the best Bubble Ghost experience yet. Players can also relive the original classic with the Original Mode, featuring levels from the Game Boy and Atari ST versions, or compete in Speedrun Mode to earn a place in the Hall of Fame.

💿 Available in digital and physical editions
The game will be released digitally on Steam and Switch, with standard and collector’s physical editions (GAME exclusive) available in select European retailers.

📝 Add it to your Nintendo Switch or Steam wishlist and don’t miss any updates!
